text_block_list.text:
Carrying those entrusted dreams,
she arrived at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—
It was just like a festival!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Umamusume representing each of their generations
have gathered in grand force today!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Making a brilliant comeback from last year's injury!
What kind of magic will she cast on the turf today—
Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! ...Well, look all you want, okay?
I'm just gonna run a race that's fun for me!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Having gloriously captured the tiara at both the Japanese Oaks and Shuka Sho this year, it's the Princess Fighter! Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Good day! Today, I have come to make a declar—ahem, extend my greetings
to everyone in the Senior class~!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Passing on the Sprinters Stakes to make an emergency entry! It's the Mile Queen, Rhein Kraft!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best today!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because there's someone that I absolutely, definitely, no matter what, refuse to lose to!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because I want to show everyone "my" radiance most of all!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“And we must not forget her!
Her daring, gallop-worthy form makes her truly a superstar!
Cesariooo!”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Today, she came here simply for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I shall be the one to unleash
my own brilliance across this autumn turf.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I will put everything on the line. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!
Speaking of Rhein Kraft and Cesario,
that heated battle at the Oka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A highly anticipated clash of rivals in today's race as well! How exciting!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I just couldn't resist coming all the way here in person~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, Cesario-san!
Give it yer all~!

"Every corner is gripped by festive excitement... amidst it all,
Cesario quietly closes her eyes alone."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(I can recall it all so vividly.
The scent of the tide, the blue beach—and your smile.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A light connecting all the way into the distant future.
Surpassing you, I will become that light.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I will be the light...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...Things have become quite busy since then,
Craft.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Pushing Trainer with unreasonable demands,
and constantly taking on as heavy a load as possible—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (I had them comb through the data for you as well as all the other running Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Running countless race simulations...
—Yes, it's all for today.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Craft... You had no reason to apologize on that day.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Even though I am robbing you of your wish—I'm glad you were here.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Because right now, I truly feel that way from the bottom of my heart, too.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
And so, the curtain rises on a life-or-death stage!
